fields.equipment: Clear floor space; optional exercise mat
fields.description: Standard push-ups from a floor plank. Use Left Side View or Right Side View for provisional visible-side tracking. Keep hips aligned, lower with control and extend fully. Floor and Wall Push-Up are separate exercises. Unreliable or recovered tracking may count without a form score.

tutorialSteps.title: Set up the camera
tutorialSteps.description: Place the camera at floor height on your left or right side. Keep shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips and ankles visible, with the near elbow clear.

tutorialSteps.title: Hold the top
tutorialSteps.description: Place palms on the floor and extend your arms in a plank from shoulders to ankles. Hold steady until Ready.

tutorialSteps.title: Lower and return
tutorialSteps.description: Lower your chest with control, keep hips aligned, and push back to extended arms. A complete observed descent and return counts once.

tutorialSteps.title: Recover and save
tutorialSteps.description: After an interruption, hold the top again. Follow the set and rest targets, then finish and save your measured summary. Incomplete movements remain partial repetitions.

blueprint.name: Standard Floor Push-Up
blueprint.goal: Practice controlled floor push-ups with visible-side guidance.
